messages:
nina: Heads-up: execs want a compact GA readiness snapshot for next week's partner call. Needs SLA blurbs, monitoring gates, support model, and pricing fallback bullets. Can we produce a 1-pager + quick checklist by Thursday?

carlos: On SLA: recommend tiered SLOs instead of a single uptime number. Hosted: 99.9 uptime / Dedicated: 99.95. Add clear exclusions (customer infra, misconfiguration).

anna: Support model: propose 24/7 oncall for Dedicated customers (paid tier), business-hours for PLG. Add emergency escalation path for data-residency incidents.

devon: For monitoring gates, call out: p95 latency per route, p99 for tail risk, and error-rate. Also add a daily synthetic quality check for generation drift (small prompt set). If drift > 5% we trigger a rollback window.

phil: Pricing fallback: need a burst policy description. Suggest: free tier throttle at X qps, standard billed by token, Dedicated gets committed baseline + burst pool billed at higher multiplier. Finance to confirm exact numbers.

beth-cs: Sales needs two things: a one-line canned onboarding checklist for deals and a short FAQ for compliance asks (SOC2, KMS, audit logs). Can product confirm commitments?

nina: Product: confirm SOC2 + audit logs are GA promises for hosted and Private. KMS/HSM integration for Private: target GA but list as "dependent on partner validation". Deletion SLA: Private <=30 days, Hosted <=90 days.

carlos: Runbook snippet I'm proposing:```
- Incident levels: Sev0 (complete outage), Sev1 (functional degradation), Sev2 (minor)
- Pager sequence: oncall -> eng lead (20m) -> SRE manager (45m) -> exec (2h)
- Credit calc trigger: when Sev0 > 30m in a 24h window
```

ops-bot: Alert created by devon: "ga_quality_drift" -> notify #eng-oncall + #product if daily_regression > 5% for 1 day

devon: For rollout policy: phased rollout with health gates: smoke -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Health gates evaluate p99, error-rate, and quality check. Auto-fallback enabled for first three phases, manual for >50%.

beth-cs: For enterprise deals we need a pre-cutover checklist: 1) network allowlist 2) TLS cert exchange 3) KMS handshake 4) provisioning validation call. Keep it short (bulleted).

phil: Commercial note: Dedicated SLA should explicitly exclude third-party network/cloud outages and customer-managed auth. Legal to provide final clause.

carlos: Test plan for GA: 48-72h soak with production-like mixtures + fault injection (simulate GPU preemption, network flaps). Pass condition: no more than 1% error budget burn and cache-warm hit rate > 80% after 6h.

anna: Support handoff: create an internal triage playbook and a canned external response template for when customers ask about incidents/credits. I'll draft templates.

nina: Timeline: owners please drop edits in the shared doc by 11am PT Wednesday. I'll assemble the 1-pager and checklist and circulate. If any owner cannot meet that timeline flag now.

beth-cs: I'll queue the sales FAQ and onboarding checklist.

devon: I'll add Prom alert rules and a sample trace span to the doc. quick example:```
alert: GA_P99_TAIL
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.0025
for: 15m
labels: { severity: "page" }
```

phil: I'll coordinate with finance on pricing numbers and post the draft fallback wording.

nina: Great. If no blockers, finalize by Thursday EOD. Flag me if anything changes.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Draft GA readiness doc pushed to staging bucket by nina
